_comment: A second brand, invented, and here to prove one thing: that the studio
knows nothing about METUPUK. This file is written by hand where the other
is generated by the build, and it shares no colour, no typeface, no mark
and no hashtag with it. Fen & Furrow is not a real organisation.
It also declares two templates rather than four. A brand is not obliged to
have thirty-one portraits or a touring exhibition, and the studio has to
cope with a brand that simply does not offer those — if it could not, the
templates would be baked in rather than described here.
name: Fen & Furrow
duotone: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) sepia(1) hue-rotate(58deg) saturate(1.4) brightness(0.95)

defaults.headline: meals grown and given away from half an acre this year
defaults.note: Every one of them within three miles of where it was picked.

defaults.quote: I came for the vegetables and stayed for the company.
